diagnosis: The checks C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, and C6 all passed in every rollout because the settlement decisions matched the default values or simple heuristics. Specifically, the digital_concurrent_users (40), print_reserve_copies (10), accessible_format (scanned PDF files), and ready_before_course_days (0) were either default values or straightforward interpretations of the provided facts S1, S2, S3, and S4. This indicates that the checks are overly permissive and do not require the hidden information PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4 to pass.
